scope: reused shared Synth Live highlighter on existing ASWAN controls
heard VGM and fresh Code observations only
source/Wave/stereo/Sweep/Noise and known Code PCM scalar fields
default-On locally remembered preference inside channel help
bounded500ms CSS pulse with reduced-motion variant
Off skips comparisons with no new timers/layout/audio operations
limitations: follows the existing sampled Live cadence, not every intermediate register write
transient VGM PCM has no recovered keyboard sample and its sample fields are not highlighted
unknown fields and hidden controls establish a fresh baseline when available
